The figures come from Table 1, "Statistics", on page 9 of the PDF (printed page 115 of the journal):

- **Total size of fetched pages:** 147.8 GB
- **Compressed repository:** 53.5 GB
- **Lexicon:** 293 MB

The text layer for this paper is a poor scan and gets all three numbers wrong. It reads them as "117.8 GB", "5.33 GB" and "203 MB". I rendered page 9 of the PDF as an image and read the values above from it.

For context, the same table (p. 9) lists 24 million web pages fetched. It also gives the total storage as 55.2 GB without the repository and 108.7 GB with it.
